title: Media Definition
description: Schema for media def TOML/JSON definitions in the CAPDAG registry

version.description: Per-definition version. Optional; absent ⇒ 0. v0 is the frozen pre-versioning state at the flat R2 path. v ≥ 1 is published at media/<sha256>/<version>.json. Bumped explicitly in source TOMLs when content changes.

title.description: Display-friendly title for the media type

description.description: Optional short plain-text description of the media type

documentation.description: Optional long-form markdown documentation of this media def itself: what is specific to it. What the dims it was built from mean is documented once, with each dim (see `dims`), and is not repeated here; a reader shows both. Rendered in media info panels, the cap navigator, capdag-dot-com, and anywhere else a rich-text explanation of the media def is useful. In TOML sources, author this as a triple-quoted literal string (''') so newlines and markdown punctuation pass through unchanged; the JSON generator re-escapes newlines per JSON rules on output.

dims.description: The dims this definition was built from, in the order its source references them: for each, the dim's name and the value chosen from it. A dim is published on its own (dim.schema.json) with its documentation and each value's; a reader shows that documentation beside this definition's own. The registry manifest says which version of each dim a snapshot holds. A dim appears at most once. Absent when the definition was built from no dim.

items.description: One dim a definition was built from, and the value chosen from it

value.description: The name of the value chosen from that dim

validation.description: Validation rules for values of this media type

metadata.description: Optional metadata for display and categorization (arbitrary key-value pairs)

extensions.description: File extensions for storing this media type (e.g., ['pdf'], ['jpg', 'jpeg']). Should not include the leading dot.
